name: The Hibbard household at 1637 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_hibbard_william_gold_jr

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1637 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1637 Mr. & Mrs. Wm. Gold Hibbard jr..

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1637, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census was read for the Prairie Avenue sheets of ED 36 and ED 40 (T623 roll 245), and this household was not found at this number on 1 June 1900, so no staff are listed. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: William Gold Hibbard jr.
persons.note: The 1904 OCR prints 'Wm. Gold Hibbard' at 1637 and the 1905 edition 'Wm. Gold Hibbard jr.'; the father's widow is listed separately at 1701 in both, so this is the son.
